items.title: 67395_Vic Dickenson oral history interview
items.q: The transcript only contains the interviewer mentioning Billy Butterfield; the interviewee (Vic Dickenson) does not speak or reference a personal relationship with him.

ctx.x: Oh yeah. So was The World's Greatest Jazz Band! Well, they didn't travel as extensively as Duke, but they traveled extensively over the United States.
Yeah, Billy Butterfield told me about some of those bus rides. It's unbelievable.
